title: Run due digests at work-set and mine weekly lessons into tagged decisions
action: Per D3 (dbbe0778) and D4 (b343870b): in work.rs, call mailbox_digest::compose_due_digests fail-open at the control root, BESIDE — never inside — the existing recovery call and its armed() early-out (anchor work.rs:300 'file_letter_at_run_end(&ctx.root, session_flag.as_deref(), status.as_deref());' and the record_silent_runs call near work.rs:396): it fires on every bee work set and relies on ld-2's idempotence; D2 letters exist in unarmed checkouts too, so the digest path must not be gated on armed(). Then the weekly fold mines lessons: source ONLY the letters' 'Broken or unfinished' bullets (anchor mailbox.rs:1522 'pub(crate) const SECTION_BROKEN: &str = "Broken or unfinished";') plus obstacle / plan-was-wrong / fix-first departure kinds — never better-route lines, never plan-followed statements (advisor P2). Normalize each line: one_line + lowercase + collapse digit runs to '#' + strip trailing punctuation. A shape qualifies when it has >=4 words and appears in letters of 2+ DISTINCT run slugs within the week. For each qualifying shape, append ONE decision tagged 'lesson' through a variant of log_decision (anchor cells/audit.rs:427 'pub(crate) fn log_decision(root: &Path, decision: &str, rationale: &str, tags: &[&str]) -> MR<()> {') that accepts source "agent"; the rationale cites the letter filenames and a stable token shape:<first 12 hex of sha256(normalized shape)>. Dedupe before logging: scan .bee/decisions.jsonl for that shape: token across ALL prior lesson-tagged events INCLUDING superseded ones — a retired lesson is never re-logged (D4). A decisions-append failure warns and still files the digest (fail-open). Tests per the plan's ld-3 triad; judge existing coverage first.

truths: bee work set on a store with a finished undigested period leaves the digest file behind
A normalized broken-shape in letters of 2 distinct runs in one week yields exactly one decision tagged lesson carrying its shape:<sha-12> token and citing the letter filenames
A shape whose token already exists in any prior lesson decision (active or superseded) is not logged again

prohibitions: Never mine better-route departures or plan-followed statements (overview rule 8)
A lesson decision states only what cited letters carry (D8)
A digest/lesson failure never refuses bee work set (fail-open)
